suggestions.assertion: shows-git-log: After commit is created, runs 'git log --oneline' showing the new commit hash and message
suggestions.reason: The assertion passes as long as any git log output appears, even if it were from a prior commit. Consider requiring the shown hash to match the newly created commit hash (i.e., the first line of log must be the commit just made).

eval_feedback.overall: Evals are solid and discriminating for the skill's intended behaviors. The shows-git-log assertion could be tightened slightly.
